ARCLUME STUDIO / THE DETAILS

Terms of service

Website use, creative examples and the first step toward working together.

Updated September 10, 2026

Private preview · Draft for business review. Legal business details and the contact address must be confirmed before public launch.

Scope of these terms

These draft terms cover the Arclume Studio website and general service inquiries. They are not a client production agreement, a confirmed quote or a booking. The legal business identity and operating jurisdiction must be confirmed before public launch.

Using the website

You may browse the site and prepare an inquiry for a legitimate business purpose. Do not use it to submit unlawful or deceptive material, impersonate another person, interfere with the service or attempt to access systems without authorization.

Creative work and examples

Images labeled “Studio concept” are independent explorations. They are not claims of a paid client relationship, finished video production, endorsement or measured campaign results. Third-party brands and recognizable products, where shown, remain associated with their respective owners.

Website copy, layouts and original creative material may be protected by intellectual property rights. Viewing them does not grant a commercial reuse licence. Any client rights to commissioned deliverables should be stated in the project agreement.

Inquiries and proposals

Saving a brief creates a file on your device; it does not contact the studio. Where email drafting is enabled, the inquiry reaches the studio only after you send the email. Neither action books a project, accepts a quote or commits you to payment.

Before work begins, both parties should agree in writing on scope, deliverables, schedule, fees, payment milestones, revisions, cancellation and any licensing or usage restrictions. No fixed refund, revision or payment policy is established by this website.

Production and supplied materials

Arclume’s proposed services may use AI-assisted production alongside creative direction, editing and sound design. The production approach, approvals, third-party licences, treatment of confidential materials and ownership of final deliverables should be addressed in the project agreement.

Only share materials you are entitled to provide. Confidential documents, account passwords and payment information should not be placed in the website brief.

Campaign outcomes

The website does not promise a particular number of views, leads, sales or return on advertising spend. Campaign outcomes depend on factors including the offer, audience, media spend, distribution and market conditions. Advertising budgets and account management are included only when expressly agreed.

Availability and external links

Website information may change and access may occasionally be interrupted. Linked social platforms are independent services. Their content and availability are outside Arclume’s control.

Privacy and consumer rights

The privacy policy explains the current handling of website information. These terms are not intended to exclude rights or obligations that applicable law does not permit the parties to exclude. Jurisdiction-specific provisions need review once the business location is confirmed.

Questions

The studio’s contact address is being finalized for this private preview. A verified address for privacy requests and other inquiries will be published before the site opens to the public.
